newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM PRECIOUS METALS END DOWN, PGMS DIVE.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM PRECIOUS METALS END DOWN, PGMS DIVE.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo precious metal futures ended lower across the board on Thursday, with some months of platinum group metals (PGMs) diving by their daily price limits, traders said.

Four months of palladium had tumbled by their 48 yen per gram daily limits by the close, with benchmark June ending at 659 yen. September platinum fell by its 75 yen per gram limit while benchmark June platinum was off 51 yen at 1,468 yen.
"Following the dive on Wednesday when a U.S.-based trader liquidated massive longs, selling pressure by private investors dominated the market," one trader said.
